He holds a white piece of paper and appears to be reading it. The setting is a modern indoor room with sleek grey kitchen cabinets and a neutral-colored wall behind him. (2) The man stands up and unrolls a large, cylindrical object wrapped in grey plastic. As it unfurls, a large circular rug with colorful cartoon character illustrations and the text "ON AIR" in a prominent red box is revealed. The camera is positioned at a high angle, looking down on the floor. (3) Two other people, a woman in a grey shirt and another man in a black shirt, join to help the man flatten the rug. (4) The man in the tank top lies down on the center of the rug, curling his body into a ball like a pet. He has a joyful expression, laughing heartily and looking towards the camera. The lighting is bright and artificial, typical of a well-lit studio or apartment. (5) Close-up shots show the man laughing while lying on the rug, covering his face with his hands. An anime-style eye graphic overlay appears momentarily. He eventually sits up, interacting with someone off-camera who hands him a card. The background shows a shelf filled with books and awards.
